title: Modifier Key Framework rule file
description: One file per mod in Data/SKSE/Plugins/ModifierKeyFramework/*.json. Comments (// and /* */) are allowed.

version.description: Rule format version this file is written for. Files without it are version 1. Version 2 (framework 1.1.0): primary and its label are optional.

translations.description: Name of the translation file for $Key labels: Interface/Translations/<name>_<LANGUAGE>.txt. Default: this file's name without .json.

id.description: Name of the rule: shown in the log, sent with the event, used by SetRuleEnabled.

target.description: What the rule applies to. Only NPCs for now.

not.description: Conditions of which none may hold.

primary.description: The action when activating normally. Without a label the prompt keeps the game's own text (e.g. Search). Optional (version 2).

alternate.description: The action while the modifier key is held. Adds the marker (default '+') to the primary label. Needs a label.

priority.description: When several rules match, the highest wins; ties go to the file name that sorts first.

enabled.description: false: off until a script calls ModifierKeyFramework.SetRuleEnabled(file, id, true).

label.description: Text on the first prompt line, or a $Key from the translation file.

event.description: SKSE mod event sent on activation: Event(String eventName, String ruleId, Float isAlternate, Form target). Without it, only the label changes and activation stays vanilla.

forms.description: One form, or a list: any one of them counts.

keyword.description: Has the keyword (on the NPC or its race).

faction.description: Is in the faction (optionally with a minimum rank). A list: any one of them.

npc.description: Is this NPC (base NPC record, not a placed reference).
